text:
Do you wish to be loved? Then do not lose

the course of your heart.

Only what you are must you be,

and what you are not, no.

Thus, in the world, your subtle manner,

your grace, your most beautiful being,

will be the object of endless praise,

and love... a simple duty.

translation.title: Do You Wish to Be Loved?
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the advice structure of the Spanish variant and its final pause before love as duty.
